moves.label: Quick Exorcist Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window that checks close pressure.
moves.reason: Compact standing punch animation with quick startup.

moves.label: Low Claw Rake
moves.description: Quick low claw rush with long active pressure across the shins.
moves.reason: Frames drop into a low forward clawing sequence.

moves.label: Crown Clown Swipe
moves.description: Fast mid claw swipe that stays active through a forward raking motion.
moves.reason: The Innocence arm extends into repeated mid-height slashes.

moves.label: Innocence Rush
moves.description: Quick mid rush with a long active claw sequence for close-range pressure.
moves.reason: The animation matches the extended claw-rush frames.

moves.label: Twin Claw Assault
moves.description: Slow mid string that chains a step-in strike into Allen's claw rush.
moves.reason: The row combines starter movement into the extended claw attack.

moves.label: Cross Grave Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher that carves upward with Allen's white Innocence arm.
moves.reason: The rising slash frames clearly lift from low to high.

moves.label: Low Innocence Feint
moves.description: Steady low feint that dips into a sweeping claw follow-through.
moves.reason: The character stays low before the claw reaches along the lower body line.

moves.label: Driving Sword Kick
moves.description: Slow low knockdown that drives forward before Allen rises into a weapon strike.
moves.reason: Low advancing setup ends in a heavy weaponized rising finish.

moves.label: Crown Clown Crush
moves.description: Long-active mid knockdown that swings Allen's Innocence through a heavy arc.
moves.reason: Wide spinning claw arc reads as a committed power crush.

moves.label: Crouching Claw Check
moves.description: Fast mid crouch check that snaps into a short claw swipe.
moves.reason: Full-crouch command uses a compact claw extension.

moves.label: Crouch Grave Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that rises from crouch into a sweeping Innocence strike.
moves.reason: The move starts low and transitions into a lifting claw sequence.

moves.label: Charged Exorcist Jab
moves.description: Fast high charge jab with a short active check from close range.
moves.reason: Charge command reuses the compact standing jab animation.

moves.label: Innocence Aura Drive
moves.description: Slow special knockdown that channels Allen's Innocence into a low driving rush.
moves.reason: Charge command and special level fit the long aura-drive sequence.

moves.label: Rising Exorcist Blade
moves.description: Slow mid rising strike that lifts Allen into a green-bladed weapon swing.
moves.reason: While-standing row visibly leaves the ground into a blade-like rising attack.

moves.label: Low-Step Jab
moves.description: Fast high poke from a low command that checks opponents with quick recovery.
moves.reason: Despite the command, the contact frames are the same high jab silhouette.

moves.label: Crown Clown Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that winds into a sweeping Crown Clown uppercut.
moves.reason: The d/f route rises through a clear launching claw arc.

moves.label: Forward Innocence Slash
moves.description: Fast mid advancing slash with long active coverage from Allen's weapon arm.
moves.reason: Forward command steps in with the green weapon before slashing forward.

moves.label: Cross Step Jab
moves.description: Fast high motion jab that keeps the active window short and simple.
moves.reason: Motion command uses the same quick standing jab frames.

moves.label: Crown Clown Burst
moves.description: Fast mid jumping knockdown that bursts forward through a weapon-arm slash.
moves.reason: The qcf finisher hops into a large weapon-arm burst and knockdown finish.
